title: Score Public Objective on a phone: compact header
description: The scoring window (Score Public Objective / Score Objective / Score Secret Objective, incl. Imperial) on phones (390x844, 360x740, landscape 844x390): one-row header with Minimize, Imperial note folded to one line with a Why? button, tighter table and footer. Desktop unchanged. Before shots from the commit without the change (TI4_SHOT_PREFIX=before). Mocked fixtures.

shots.heading: After: Imperial, 8 objectives, phone 390x844
shots.caption: One-row header with Minimize, one-line Imperial note with a Why? button; 8 rows in the list, footer in view.

notes.title: Where
notes.text: web/src/components/ObjectivesModal.tsx and .css; phone breakpoint (max-width 720px or max-height 500px) as elsewhere. Only copy served by the alpha (web/dist); web2 has no such component.

notes.title: Assertions
notes.text: Per phone size: header <= 52 px and Minimize on the header row, >= 3 rows fully visible (2 in landscape), footer and Confirm inside the viewport, no horizontal overflow; desktop keeps subtitle, badge and full Imperial text.
